title: Qwen3.8-27B BF16 · Ascend 910B3

lede.zh: 在难题上，xhigh 的 E2E 中位耗时达到 medium 的 3.1–5.1 倍；low 与 medium 在本实验分辨率下不可区分。
lede.en: On hard prompts, xhigh median E2E time is 3.1–5.1× that of medium; low and medium are indistinguishable at this experiment’s resolution.

snapshot.zh: reasoning_effort none / low / medium / xhigh · 3 repeats
snapshot.en: reasoning_effort none / low / medium / xhigh · 3 repeats

heading.zh: 推理强度不是简单的速度档位
heading.en: Reasoning effort is not a simple speed setting

intro.zh: 参数影响取决于题目难度。xhigh 在 easy 题上产生更短输出，但 hard 题上增加输出与耗时；low 与 medium 的差异落在实验噪声范围内。
intro.en: The effect depends on prompt difficulty. xhigh produces shorter outputs on easy prompts but increases output and time on hard prompts; low and medium fall within the experiment’s noise range.

note.zh: 该报告测的是同一 BF16 权重在推理强度设置下的服务成本，不是不同模型或精度之间的比较。结论基于难度平衡的 24 条提示和三次独立测量。
note.en: This report measures serving cost for one BF16 checkpoint under reasoning-effort settings; it is not a comparison across models or precisions. Conclusions use 24 difficulty-balanced prompts and three independent measurements.

heading.zh: xhigh 在难题上显著增加输出长度与端到端时间；low 与 medium 难以区分
heading.en: xhigh increases output length and end-to-end time on hard prompts; low and medium are not distinguishable here

intro.zh: Qwen3.8-27B BF16、8 × Ascend 910B3、TP4。四档 reasoning_effort 使用同一服务实例与同一组难度平衡题目。
intro.en: Qwen3.8-27B BF16 on 8 × Ascend 910B3 with TP4. Four reasoning_effort levels used the same serving instance and difficulty-balanced prompts.

notes.zh: easy 题的方向不同：xhigh 的输出 token 中位数约为 medium 的 0.37–0.41 倍；hard 题则约为 3.0–5.0 倍。难度分层后再看参数，整体均值会掩盖这种分叉。
notes.en: The direction differs on easy prompts: xhigh uses about 0.37–0.41× the median output tokens of medium, while on hard prompts it uses about 3.0–5.0×. Difficulty-stratified results reveal a split that aggregate averages would hide.

title.zh: Hard 题端到端时间中位数
title.en: Median end-to-end time on hard prompts

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: xhigh 的回答速率为 low 的 0.24–0.38 倍；单流 TTFT/TPOT 未分辨出差异
heading.en: xhigh answers at 0.24–0.38× the rate of low; single-stream TTFT/TPOT differences were unresolved

intro.zh: 每档共 24 条提示，easy/medium/hard 各 8 条；四档看到相同难度构成。三次独立测量方向一致。
intro.en: Each round used 24 prompts, eight per easy/medium/hard tier; all effort levels saw the same difficulty mix. The directional result was consistent across three independent measurements.

notes.zh: p99 样本不足以作为尾延迟承诺；C32 TTFT 因噪声过高不报告。xhigh 有 2.8%–12.5% 的截断率，真实 token 与时延成本可能更高。
notes.en: The sample is insufficient for p99 service claims; C32 TTFT is omitted because its noise floor is too high. xhigh truncation ranges from 2.8% to 12.5%, so uncapped token and latency costs may be higher.

title.en: Answer rate on the mixed prompt set

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

methodIntro: 四档使用同一实例、同一抽样参数和相同难度分布；自然 EOS，prefix cache off。各项按难度分层统计。
All four settings use the same instance, sampling parameters, and difficulty mix; natural EOS with prefix cache off. Results are stratified by difficulty.

methodNotes.zh: p99 仅 24/72 个样本，不满足尾分位样本门槛；C32 TTFT 不作为结论。
methodNotes.en: p99 uses only 24/72 samples and does not meet the tail-percentile sample threshold; C32 TTFT is not reported as a conclusion.

methodNotes.zh: xhigh 的部分请求触达 30,000 token 上限；本文成本应视为该上限下的观测值。
methodNotes.en: Some xhigh requests hit the 30,000-token cap; reported costs are observations under that cap.
